environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). The application runs as a systemd service under user 'appuser' which has read access to /etc/shadow due to legacy PAM configuration. The /var/data/uploads directory is a shared NFS mount where multiple services write files. No request rate limiting is configured at any layer. The NLB performs TCP passthrough with no HTTP inspection.

config.upload_dir_mount: NFS shared mount, writable by multiple services
